text_block_list.text:
"Tenno Sho (Spring): A Clash of the Top Two!!"
"Kitasan Black VS Satono Diamond"

"Two childhood friends battle for the title of the strongest!
Upon whom will the Goddess of Victory smile!?"

—Every article regarding the Tenno Sho (Spring)
was splashed with headlines hyping the "Clash of the Big Two."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"A clash between the big two... It's so fun
because they have completely different styles, right?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Known even before her debut as the "230-Million-Point Young Lady," Satono Diamond already enjoyed immense renown and high expectations—

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black, who had little name recognition at first, but climbed her way up by winning hearts with her earnestness and sheer grit...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, they're close childhood friends.
It really feels like a clash between two fated rivals!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
“Still, Kitasan Black might have the edge today.
She won last year, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Man with Glasses
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) is 3,200m, the longest of all GI races.
With the steep elevation changes along Yodo's curves,
positioning—as well as stamina—is the key.

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text: What's with this all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Man with Glasses
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black ran in this race last year, giving her an advantage... Wait, I feel like we've had a similar conversation before.

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's the one!
The Mejiro McQueen vs. Tokai Teio matchup
in that same Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Man with Glasses
text_block_list.text: I see... It certainly feels just like back then...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aha, so everyone feels like today's showdown
is just like how it was for us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The two who looked up to Teio-san and me, in the very same Tenno Sho (Spring)...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I feel a strange sort of fate between us.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Since they've watched our races in the past,
we want them to run even better than we did!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It must at least be
on par with our past selves.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"A clash between the top two...
I'm simply glad I could play a part in building the hype."
choice_data_list: So that's how Diamond sees it, huh
So that's how Diamond sees it

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. I believe this is 'contributing to the Umamusume world from within'—something the Satono family has never been able to do before.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I truly want to thank everyone who took the time to interview me even before my debut.
choice_data_list: Because I've always handled my interviews with sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu♪
And it's also thanks to Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan has always worked so hard to bring smiles to everyone,
which is why she's receiving this much attention now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The way to be as a "great Umamusume"...
I feel like I can find it by running with Kita-chan after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And in order to become a "renowned Umamusume,"
I must win.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan has the advantage of having run the Tenno Sho (Spring) last year,
but that is precisely what gives meaning to victory.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll win this race and become an Umamusume
that everyone unreservedly acknowledges as the strongest!
